title: The War That Started After A Soccer Game
description:
In June 1969 El Salvador and Honduras met in a two-leg qualifier for the 1970 FIFA World Cup (Honduras won 1-0, El Salvador 3-0), with rioting around the games and already high tensions. On 14 July 1969 El Salvador attacked Honduras in what is nicknamed the Football War or 100 Hour War. The Organization of American States arranged a cease-fire on the night of 18 July. The war was a major factor in starting the Salvadoran Civil War a decade later.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Football War'. The war had deeper causes than the match.
